description: This is a CMake script defining functions for configuring header-only libraries and packages, including generating configuration files and installing them, tailored toward managing header-only dependencies with templates and versioning support.

methods.name: HeaderOnlyInstallCMakeConfig
methods.description: Defines a configuration function for installing and generating CMake config files for header-only libraries, handling dependencies, templates, and target properties.

methods.name: HeaderOnlyInstallPackageConfig
methods.description: Defines a configuration function for generating and installing pkg-config files for header-only packages, including handling compile options, include directories, and linking information.
